name: Saptarshi Debnath
summary: Visionary Technical Architect and Staff Engineer with expansive expertise in designing, scaling, and modernizing high-latency, cloud-native distributed systems. Proven track record of leading architectural transformations, driving organizational engineering standards, and mentoring cross-functional teams to deliver highly available, zero-trust infrastructure. Seeking to leverage deep expertise in system design and microservices as a Principal Architect to drive enterprise-wide technical strategy.

experience.web_summary: Leading cloud-native microservices architecture and technical strategy for global, high-scale reservations and property management systems.
highlights: Architecting and defining the technical vision for NextGen distributed systems serving millions of daily users with single-digit millisecond latency.
Spearheading the migration of monolithic legacy systems to resilient, containerized, cloud-native microservices using Spring Boot, AWS, and Kubernetes.
Establishing engineering standards and asynchronous communication patterns (Kafka) across multiple engineering pods.
Mentoring senior engineering teams on system design, distributed data patterns, operational excellence, and CI/CD best practices.

experience.web_summary: Developed scalable backend services, optimized cloud deployments, and implemented fault-tolerant data pipelines.
highlights: Designed and developed highly scalable, secure, and fault-tolerant RESTful microservices for enterprise integration.
Optimized JVM performance, database queries, and cloud resource allocation, reducing infrastructure costs by 15%.
Implemented circuit breakers, bulkheads, and centralized logging to ensure robust system observability and prevent cascading failures.
Collaborated with product and infrastructure teams to streamline DevOps workflows utilizing Jenkins, Git, and Docker.

experience.web_summary: Key member of the System Team acting as DevOps and Full Stack Engineer for enterprise modernization initiatives.
highlights: Engineered full-stack solutions and orchestrated deployment pipelines using Java, Spring, Hibernate, and AWS.
Drove Agile adoption by integrating automated testing (Cucumber) and continuous integration (Jenkins) into the deployment lifecycle.
Migrated critical on-premise databases to managed cloud SQL/NoSQL solutions, improving read throughput by 3x.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology (B-Tech), Computer Science and Engineering
